capabilities: Generate filenames from note content with AI
Rename notes automatically or after review
Connect a Constance account and buy credits
Validate suggested Windows folder names before renaming
extras: The README is mostly about account setup, billing via Paddle/Constance, and privacy of data sent to external services; actual renaming usage is described only briefly. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to rename notes based on what they contain, so messy filenames must be fixed manually.
summary: AI-powered file renamer that generates filenames from Markdown note content and renames files automatically or after review.
